Chapter One

The Woman Behind My Smile

She has the kind of eyes that make a room feel quieter — like everything softens the second she looks at you. A smile that arrives slowly and then all at once, the kind you'd cross a city for.

But it was never only the way she looks. It's the heart underneath it — kind in a way that doesn't perform for anyone, strong in a way she rarely announces. She's sharp, thoughtful, endlessly curious, the sort of intelligent that asks better questions than it gives answers. Graceful under pressure. Soft with the people she loves, and fierce for them too.

She carries herself like someone who has survived things quietly and decided to be gentle anyway. That, more than anything, is what I fell for.

“

Beautiful eyes. Beautiful smile. A heart that's even more beautiful up close.

Chapter Two

Our Story

The whole thing started so small, I almost missed it.

  1. ✦

    The Vendor Stand

    She texted me asking for a vendor stand during an event I helped organize. A small, practical, forgettable question — except I never forgot it.

  2. ✦

    The Conversation

    That simple conversation became the beginning of everything. What was supposed to be one reply turned into hours of talking, then days, then a habit I never wanted to break.

  3. ✦

    Something Different

    I knew from the very first day that there was something different about her. Not louder, not flashier — just different. The kind of different you don't question, you just follow.

  4. ✦

    Chosen

    Life chose her for me. I just had the good sense not to get in the way of it.

Chapter Three

Why Snow?

She isn't called Snow because she's cold.

She reminds me of Elsa — strong, elegant, different. Someone who learned to stop hiding what makes her powerful.

She carries burdens silently, protects the people around her without asking for credit, and loves deeply even when deeply hasn't always loved her back.

She keeps standing even after storms. Every single time.

That's why she's my Snow.

Every chapter she was sure would break her — she survived anyway.

2019 — 2025

University & The Project

Late nights, harder mornings, a final year project that demanded everything — and got it.

Graduation

Sign Out

She walked out of that gate carrying every version of herself that almost gave up, and she did it smiling.

Fought privately. Won mostly alone. Never once made it everyone else's burden.

Loss

Grief that would've flattened most people — she carried it and kept moving anyway.

Building something from little, doubting the numbers, doing it again the next day regardless.

Learning who stays and who doesn't — and staying soft through all of it.

Chapter Nine

A Letter For You

Click the envelope.

My Snow,

I don't know how to write this without it sounding smaller than it is, so forgive me if the words fall short of what I actually feel.

Before you, I didn't understand what people meant when they said someone felt like home. I do now. It's the way my shoulders drop the second I hear your voice. It's the way ordinary days stop being ordinary because you're in them.

I've watched you carry things that would have broken someone else, and I've watched you keep choosing softness anyway. I've watched you doubt yourself in rooms where you were clearly the best thing in them. I need you to know — I see all of it. The strength you think is quiet is the loudest thing about you to me.

You didn't just become my girlfriend. You became my favourite place to be. My calm in the middle of everything. The person I want to build a whole, ordinary, beautiful life with — grocery runs and inside jokes and every plain Tuesday in between.

So this is me, in writing, promising you the parts of me I don't say out loud enough: my patience, my honesty, my whole heart, on the good days and the hard ones.

Thank you for choosing me back. I will spend a very long time trying to deserve it.

Forever yours,
Rei ❤️

tap to open

Chapter Ten

Open When

For the days you need a piece of me and I'm not there yet.

Whatever it is, it's allowed to hurt. You don't have to be okay for me. Just breathe, text me, and let me carry a little of it with you. This feeling is a visitor, not a resident. I love you through every version of this.

Rest. You don't have to earn it. You've been strong enough for long enough today. Put everything down, even for an hour. I'll still be proud of you tomorrow, exactly as tired and exactly as loved.

We're on the same side, even right now. I'd rather work through this with you a hundred times than walk away once. Take the space you need — I'm not going anywhere.

I miss you too, probably at this exact second. Distance doesn't change anything about how I feel — it just makes the next hug longer. Call me. I'll pick up.

You are so much more than the voice in your head right now is telling you. I've watched you build things out of nothing and survive things that should've stopped you. Believe me before you believe the doubt.

Good. Stay right there. This is my favourite version of you, and I want a front row seat to it, always. Tell me everything.

Happy birthday to the reason my days got softer. I hope this year gives you every quiet joy you deserve and a few loud ones too. I'm endlessly grateful the world made you.

Another year of choosing you, and it never once felt like a choice — it felt like the easiest, most obvious thing I've ever done. Here's to every year after this one.

Since January 25, 2025
